profile.name: Aniekan Winner Anietie
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience specializing in high-performance Python backends and React frontends. Proven track record of shipping AI-integrated products that drive measurable growth (60% retention) in Fintech and Healthtech. Expert in building offline-first PWAs and scalable RAG pipelines.

highlights: Lead Developer for PRESS, a mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) built with React, TypeScript, and Shadcn UI to digitize blood pressure monitoring.
Engineered an offline-first architecture utilizing Service Workers and custom caching strategies to ensure 100% uptime for medical data entry during network outages.
Architected a multi-layered anti-fraud system to validate medical readings using ML-based image verification and EXIF metadata analysis.
Developed a Fintech module with wallet metrics, secure payouts, and an integrated LMS.
Optimized healthcare platforms (Meditrina, Zoi, Healthsend), increasing user retention by 60%+ and conversion by 35%.
Established CI/CD for the web stack, reducing release defects.
Architected and shipped production-ready web applications using FastAPI and React, improving API reliability by 45%.
Optimized legacy production services, resulting in an 18% reduction in API latency.
Engineered internal RAG tooling using Python, Ollama, and ChromaDB for semantic search across technical documentation.
Developed an intelligent SQL routing layer using DuckDB to translate natural-language queries into parameterized SQL.
Streamlined team workflows by building custom data access utilities.
